item.title: 【UPSCALED】Gwen Stefani - Cool (Remastered & AIUpscale ProRes 1080p PAL LPCM)-v2
item.description:
Source: original SD ProRes master: https://sharemania.us/threads/gwen-stefani-cool.300616/

This version was rebuilt from a restored ProRes master and processed shot by shot rather than using one global setting for the entire video.

The video was split into individual scene segments, with different processing approaches used depending on the content of each shot. Close-up beauty shots, soft-focus scenes, architecture, fine line patterns, dark areas, and high-motion transitions were treated separately to avoid a one-size-fits-all upscale.

For quality control, the upscale was exported as full-frame PNG sequences first, then reassembled into a ProRes 422 HQ master. This helped avoid extra compression during processing and made it easier to replace or refine individual problem segments before final assembly.

Several difficult shots were manually reviewed and reprocessed where needed, especially scenes with fine patterns, reflective floors, railings, and texture instability. The final version keeps the original 25fps timing and uses the original PCM audio.

The goal was not to create an overly sharpened modern look, but to preserve the soft, warm, early-2000s music video aesthetic while improving clarity, stability, and overall presentation at 1080p.
